Security policy

Source: .github/SECURITY.md

tidycreel.connect reads creel survey data from files, databases and REST APIs using credentials the user supplies. The data it returns can include personal information about anglers. Reports of anything that could expose a credential or that data are welcome.

Reporting a vulnerability

Please report privately, not in a public issue:

  • Use GitHub’s Report a vulnerability button on the Security tab of this repository, or
  • email the maintainer at the address in DESCRIPTION.

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and which version or commit you used. Do not include real credentials or real survey records; a description of their shape is enough.

You should get an acknowledgement within a week. Once a fix is released, the report can be disclosed, with credit if you want it.

In scope

  • A credential (database password, API token or key) sent somewhere it should not go, unencrypted, or shown in output, a log or an error message.
  • Personal data in the returned rows exposed beyond what the connection is mapped to carry.
  • The package’s CI or release process being usable to change the code users install.

Supported versions

Only the latest commit on main is supported. There are no maintained release branches.
